scope: Native actual decoded frames; independent original-cell/registered patch reconstruction, explicit continuity checks, independently timed mosaic occupancy and components, old/new learning-region comparison and AAC packet/timestamp identity. No renderer or staged full-frame PNG import; selected contacts, not a human continuous-playback claim.

actor.reference_metrics: full-corridor maximum perRGB-channel MAE; local feature luma MAE

native_visible_slot_group_centering.method: Actual decoded RGB palette contrast mask includes active fills and inactive outlines; raster_centering_report checks horizontal/vertical independently, containment, nonempty and edge clearance.

progress.method: Native active-teal mask; every fixed tile core tested against independently timed row-major ordinal; separate four-connected components for all 169 ordinal states including zero.

learning_region.method: Independent old/new decode, crop, identical FFmpeg scale, absolute RGB difference; complements separate native glyph checks.
